latest_release.name: v2.2.2
latest_release.body:
# Merlin Server v2.2.2

**Security release** — fixes an authenticated operator → teamserver remote code execution in the SharpGen module. Upgrading is recommended for anyone running a Merlin teamserver.

## Security

### GHSA-gmq6-43v4-9vrv — SharpGen operator-to-server RCE
The SharpGen module passed the operator-supplied `dotnetbin` and `sharpgenbin` options straight into `exec.Command()` after only checking that the files existed — not that they were the expected executables. An authenticated operator could set `dotnetbin=/bin/bash` and `sharpgenbin=<a file downloaded to the server>` and execute arbitrary commands on the teamserver, frequently as **root**.

- **Severity:** Low (requires an authenticated operator)
- **Affected:** Merlin Server ≤ 2.2.1
- **Fixed in:** 2.2.2
- Reported by [@lesteratSOL](https://github.com/lesteratSOL) — thank you for the responsible disclosure.

## Changes

**Fixed**
- Pin the `dotnet` executable and the SharpGen compiler DLL to fixed, server-side locations so an operator can no longer choose which binary the server runs. Compiling arbitrary C# still works — that input is compiler data, never executed on the server.

**Changed**
- Removed the now-inert `dotnetbin` and `sharpgenbin` options from the SharpGen module (both the module definition and the RPC handler).

**Added**
- New `-dotnetBin` server flag to configure the path to the `dotnet` executable (default `dotnet`, resolved from `PATH`). This is a **server-launch** setting — chosen by whoever runs the teamserver, not an operator-controllable option — so it restores install-location flexibility without reopening the vulnerability.

## Upgrade notes
- **Server-only release.** The Merlin Agent and Merlin CLI are unaffected and do not need updating for this fix.
- If you previously pointed the SharpGen module at a `dotnet` outside your `PATH` (e.g. installed via `dotnet-install.sh` to `~/.dotnet`), set it at launch instead:
  ```bash
  ./merlinServer -dotnetBin /path/to/dotnet ...
  ```
- The SharpGen compiler DLL is now always loaded from `data/src/cobbr/SharpGen/bin/release/netcoreapp2.1/SharpGen.dll` under the Merlin root (the standard submodule build location).

---

**The `data/bin` directory contains compiled versions of the Merlin CLI and Merlin Agents**

Merlin documentation and Wiki can be found [here](https://merlin-c2.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)

> The compressed files have a password of `merlin`
